say:2:1130910001:1.text: It's like night and day! They've completely calmed down!
say:2:1130910001:1.source_cn: 不，区别可大了，它们现在不会主动攻击我们了！

say:3:1130910002:1.text: And now that the trade route is secure, we can finally make our way to the Crimson Highlands.
say:3:1130910002:1.source_cn: 这样一来，商路就畅通了，我们可以继续出发去深红高原了。

say:4:1130910003:1.text: But I heard a bunch of strange black Hypofiends have appeared there...
say:4:1130910003:1.source_cn: 但我听说，深红高原有奇怪的黑色魔物……

say:5:1130910004:1.text: Use your head, would you? If the treasure in the Crimson Highlands was a lie, then these Hypofiends probably are, too! How do you expect to do any business when you believe everything you hear?
say:5:1130910004:1.source_cn: 好好想想，深红高原的宝藏是假的，那魔物传言也可能是假的...
